videoSource.title: Video Source (e.g. /dev/video0)
videoSource.description: Full ffmpeg input arguments for your camera. Tip for low CPU: include -input_format mjpeg if your webcam supports MJPEG.

fingerprint.title: Camera Fingerprint (leave blank to generate automatically)
fingerprint.description: If left blank, a fingerprint will be generated and saved on first run.

debugLogging.title: Enable Debug Logging
debugLogging.description: Print detailed logs for troubleshooting. Leave off under normal operation.

rebroadcastEnabled.title: Enable Video Rebroadcasting [Experimental]
rebroadcastEnabled.description: Enabling will allow this plugin to exclusively own the camera and exposes an MJPEG stream & snapshot URL for other plugins to use, preventing errors caused by multiple plugins trying to access the device simultaneously. Recommended if you also use Camera FFmpeg or any other process that might access the webcam.

streamFrameRate.title: Rebroadcast Stream Frame Rate
streamFrameRate.description: Frames per second for the rebroadcast MJPEG stream. (Ignored in MJPEG passthrough mode.)

streamQuality.title: Rebroadcast Stream Quality (1-10)
streamQuality.description: Higher is better image quality (and higher bandwidth). Not used in MJPEG passthrough mode.

snapshotUploadLimitSec.title: Rebroadcast Snapshot Upload Limit (seconds)
snapshotUploadLimitSec.description: Only upload if the latest frame is newer than this many seconds.
